For security-sensitive findings, stop and use [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/organicbitcoin/obtcd/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
Do not post exploit details, credentials, wallet material, private endpoints,
or personal filesystem paths in a public report.

## Short Feedback

A few sentences are enough.

- What worked?
- Where did you get stuck or confused?
- Did `obtc.getexpiry` work?
- Did `obtc.renew` confirm?

## Optional Details

- OS / architecture:
- Go version:
- `obtcd` commit or tag:
- `obtcwallet` commit or tag:
- Node height:
- Best block hash:
- Funding txid:
- Renew txid:

## Safety Check

- [ ] I removed seed phrases, private keys, wallet private passphrases, RPC passwords, private paths, private IPs, and sensitive screenshots.
- [ ] I understand testnet coins have no real-world value.
